annotations.title: Change where a QR code points

description: Changes the URL a "redirect" QR code sends people to, so a printed code can point somewhere new. Requires Pro ($9/month) and the code's owner: signed in (OAuth) or an API key (Authorization: Bearer qrcd_...) whose owner owns the code. If the owner doesn't have Pro, it returns pro_required; if the code belongs to someone else, not_owner. The new URL gets the same safety checks as create_qr_code.

id.description: QR code ID, e.g. "QR-ABCD1234EF". Must be a "redirect" code to have any effect on scans.

url.description: The new destination, an http or https URL.

name: update_destination
